'''Wisel''' was a [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] who owned a [[Wisel's|weapons shop]] on [[Vergesso Base]].

Hhe had several connections and knew other [[merchant/Legends|merchants]] who had access to bigger [[weapon/Legends|weapons]], outdated vehicles or even [[starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. A helpful and obliging individual, he was eager to bring his customers into contact with those colleagues, typically with a markup of 50-150%.
